$ [linux] stk install --group agents
error: --user is required (usage: stk install --user <name> [--group <name>] [--state-dir /var/lib/stk] [--runtime-dir /run/stk] [--config /etc/stk/supertoolkit.yaml] [--agent-uid N]... [--proxy-port 8899] [--unit-name stk] [--dry-run])

$ [linux] stk install --user stk --unit-name bad.service --agent-uid 1000 --dry-run
error: invalid --unit-name "bad.service": want letters, digits, _ . - (starting with a letter or digit, at most 64), without a .service suffix or @
--- output
--- runs


$ [linux] stk install --user stk --group=agents --agent-uid 1000 --agent-uid=1001 --proxy-port 9000 --dry-run
ok
--- output
would ensure system user "stk" (group "agents", no home, nologin)
would ensure /var/lib/stk 0700 owned by stk
would ensure /run/stk 0750 owned by stk:agents
would generate /var/lib/stk/stk-passphrase.key 0400 if absent (never printed)
would ensure /etc/stk 0750; config, if present, 0640 root:agents
you must add each agent user to group agents (install runs no usermod)
would write /etc/systemd/system/stk.service:

[Unit]
Description=supertoolkit credential broker
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=stk
Group=agents
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/stk /run/stk
UMask=0077
RuntimeDirectory=stk
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0750
RuntimeDirectoryPreserve=yes
LoadCredential=stk-passphrase:/var/lib/stk/stk-passphrase.key
Environment=STK_HOME=/var/lib/stk STK_CONFIG=/etc/stk/supertoolkit.yaml STK_SOCKET=/run/stk/stk.sock
ExecStart=$STK serve --proxy-listen 127.0.0.1:9000 --socket-mode 0660 --allow-uid 1000 --allow-uid 1001
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
--- runs


$ [linux] stk install --user stk --agent-uid 1000 --unit-name stk-two --state-dir /srv/stk --dry-run
ok
--- output
would ensure system user "stk" (group "stk", no home, nologin)
would ensure /srv/stk 0700 owned by stk
would ensure /run/stk 0700 owned by stk:stk
would generate /srv/stk/stk-passphrase.key 0400 if absent (never printed)
would ensure /etc/stk 0750; config, if present, 0640 root:stk
would write /etc/systemd/system/stk-two.service:

[Unit]
Description=supertoolkit credential broker (stk-two)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=stk
Group=stk
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/srv/stk /run/stk
UMask=0077
RuntimeDirectory=stk
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
RuntimeDirectoryPreserve=yes
LoadCredential=stk-passphrase:/srv/stk/stk-passphrase.key
Environment=STK_HOME=/srv/stk STK_CONFIG=/etc/stk/supertoolkit.yaml STK_SOCKET=/run/stk/stk.sock
ExecStart=$STK serve --proxy-listen 127.0.0.1:8899 --socket-mode 0600 --allow-uid 1000
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
--- runs
